old: When inspecting an apartment, Hungarian uses specific adverbial phrases: *megtekintett állapotban bérbe vesz* (rents in inspected condition), *jó állapotban van*, and *bútorozottan / gépesítve bérli*.
new: You know the ending *-ban/-ben* from A1 Unit 5. Tenancy texts use it for the condition of a flat: *megtekintett állapotban* (in the condition seen at the viewing), *jó állapotban van* (is in good condition). A flat is *bútorozott* (furnished) or *gépesített* (with appliances), and you rent it with *bérbe vesz*.
